summary: End-to-end browser test of the new cloud media upload feature on the Candice Ferragamo static site + FastAPI backend. All 6 requested scenarios PASS: (1) admin cloud photo upload via chunked POST puts an absolute /api/media/file/<id> URL into localStorage.candice_media and injects img.injected-media in the gallery tile, (2) the served file actually renders (naturalWidth > 0), (3) the uploaded image persists across full page reload, (4) POST /api/media/upload/init with X-Admin-Pass: 'wrong' returns 401 from browser origin, (5) URL-paste media flow (picsum) still works unchanged, (6) GET /api/health returns {status:'ok', storage_ready:true}. Backend also curl-verified independently.

test_results.admin_cloud_photo_upload: PASS - Age gate -> #backstage -> password candice2026 -> Change photo -> pick tiny PNG -> #btnMediaSave shows 'UPLOADING…' -> toast 'Media saved' -> img.injected-media inserted, src = https://<host>/api/media/file/<uuid>, localStorage.candice_media contains that URL (not data:)
test_results.uploaded_image_loads: PASS - injected img naturalWidth = 4 (>0), file served by backend renders
test_results.persistence_across_reload: PASS - after reload + age gate, tile still shows img with same /api/media/file/<uuid> URL, naturalWidth > 0
test_results.wrong_password_returns_401: PASS - fetch /api/media/upload/init with X-Admin-Pass:'wrong' from browser origin -> HTTP 401
test_results.url_paste_regression: PASS - URL tab with https://picsum.photos/400/500 saved into localStorage.candice_media, picker closed

critical_code_review_comments: admin.js uploadToCloud() uses location.origin as API base — correct for k8s ingress but couples admin to being served from same origin as the FastAPI backend. If the exported single-file HTML is ever opened from a different origin (e.g. file://), uploads will fail silently. Minor, existing behavior.

backend/server.py init_storage() uses a module-global storage_key with no locking — under concurrent /api/media/file requests during startup two workers can race init_storage(force=True). Fine for single-worker dev, worth a lock for prod.

backend/server.py upload_complete() reads/concatenates all chunk parts in-memory before PUT to Emergent Object Storage — for the 200MB max this is up to 200MB per request in RAM. Acceptable given limits but streaming would be safer.

MAX_SIZE (200MB) is enforced only in /complete after all chunks written to /tmp/media_uploads/<id>/. A malicious admin with valid password could fill disk before hitting the size check. Low-risk (auth-gated) but consider size accumulator during /chunk.
check_pass() header comparison is plaintext ==; timing-safe compare (hmac.compare_digest) would be a small hardening win.
/tmp/media_uploads/<upload_id> is only cleaned up on /complete success/failure — abandoned uploads (client aborts after /init) leak directories forever. Add a periodic sweeper.
Frontend has no data-testid attributes (already flagged in iteration_1); existing IDs are sufficient but data-testids would harden future E2E.
test_credentials: Admin password: candice2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md); also used as X-Admin-Pass header value for /api/media/upload/*
seed_data_creation: One 4x4 red PNG uploaded via UI and left in Emergent Object Storage under candice-portfolio/uploads/<uuid>.png (file record id 753f78a0-5a76-4dd4-87b7-cf23ce34cb35). Also one picsum URL entry left in localStorage. No cleanup needed — cloud store is dev bucket.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloud upload flow is fully working end-to-end in the real browser. Key gotchas: (a) mediaPicker uses .show class + display:none — after upload it becomes hidden, so playwright's `wait_for_selector('#mediaPicker:not(.show)')` with default visible state hangs; use `page.wait_for_function(() => !el.classList.contains('show'))` instead. (b) `.media-edit-btn` inside gallery tiles are hover-visible (opacity/pointer-events); playwright wait_for_selector state='visible' will fail, so use state='attached' or trigger the click via `page.evaluate` (btn.click()). (c) After the very first reload where localStorage is cleared, age gate reappears; after subsequent reloads with candice_age_ok stored it does NOT — guard both paths. (d) Video upload path is identical to photo path — code coverage-wise no need to test the 200MB video separately.
